limitations: Leak detection remains unverified under the established ST-008 tracing accommodation; ASan/UBSan pass with command-local detect_leaks=0.
Native acceptance covers GNU/Linux Debug shared Engine; other platforms/custom allocators, installed SDK/mixed-version ABI and wider runtime integration remain unverified.
Allocation probe covers bounded C++ allocations on the serialized owner thread, not arbitrary C/custom allocators or exhaustive fault injection.
Transitions are owned observations, not live authority, authenticated history, durable delivery, application rollback or external exactly-once crash behavior.
